title: Joshua 14
paragraphs: ¹ These are the territories that the Israelites received as their inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the tribal families of Israel distributed to them. ² Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses. ³ Moses had already given the two and a half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan, but he gave the Levites no inheritance among the rest. ⁴ The descendants of Joseph had become two tribes — Manasseh and Ephraim — and no share of the land was given to the Levites except cities to live in, along with their surrounding pasturelands for their livestock and property. ⁵ The Israelites carried out the LORD's command to Moses and divided the land.

⁶ The men of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God about you and me at Kadesh Barnea. ⁷ I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out this land, and I brought back an honest report. ⁸ My fellow spies made the hearts of the people melt with fear, but I followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly. ⁹ On that day Moses swore, saying, The land you walked on will be your inheritance and your children's forever, because you followed the LORD your God wholeheartedly. ¹⁰ Now then, the LORD has kept me alive these forty-five years, just as he promised, since the day he said this to Moses while Israel wandered in the wilderness. Here I am today, eighty-five years old.

¹¹ I am still just as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. I have the same strength for battle now as I had then. ¹² So give me this hill country the LORD promised me that day. You heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified — but if the LORD is with me, I will drive them out just as he said. ¹³ Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance. ¹⁴ So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the LORD God of Israel wholeheartedly. ¹⁵ Hebron's former name was Kiriath Arba, named after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakites. And the land had rest from war.
